## Additional context

For installation problems, include the relevant Compose settings (such as `user`, volume mapping, and image tag) and the error text, after redacting all passwords, initial-password log lines, keys, tokens, private addresses and personal information. Never attach `.env`, `users.json`, secrets, or an entire data directory. Report security vulnerabilities privately through the Security tab instead.
